description: Fetch a specific agent file's contents (system prompt, tool definitions, etc.). Wraps `agents.files.get`. Read-only. Pass either `path` (full path including the file name) or `name` (file basename) — not both.

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

name.description: File basename. Pass either this or `path`.

path.description: Full file path (e.g. 'system.md'). Pass either this or `name`.

name: openclaw_agents_files_get
